title: The Supreme Court revives a controversial data system for citizenship checks - NPR
description: The Supreme Court is allowing use of a data system that Trump officials overhauled. The system has erroneously flagged U.S. citizens and a lower court found it violated federal privacy protections.

title: Man City refuse to deny guilty verdicts in Premier League 115 breaches case - sources - ESPN
description: Manchester City on Friday did not deny there has been a guilty verdict in the majority of charges of financial breaches in their legal case with the Premier League.

title: Florida’s Private Railroad Brightline Files for Bankruptcy - Bloomberg.com
description: Florida’s Brightline has filed for bankruptcy protection after years of lower-than-expected revenue left it unable to repay billions it borrowed to finance the Miami-to-Orlando private railroad.

title: iPad Mini 8 Leaked: A20 Pro Chip, Landscape Camera, and More - MacRumors
description: Apple's next-generation iPad mini will feature the A20 Pro chip, a rearranged front-facing camera, and a new speaker system, leaked code reveals....

title: Ed Sheeran's Gillette Stadium concerts canceled due to nor'easter, tour promoter says - CBS News
description: Ed Sheeran's​ Gillette Stadium concerts in Foxboro, Massachusetts, have been canceled as Boston braces for a nor'easter.
